events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: Fast and right aren't the same job. You want right, or you want fast?

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: That'll outlast the wagon it's bolted to. My father taught me not to sign worse work.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: Standing work, not a favor. I'll take that arrangement.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: You handed me the hammer back the same way you handed it over. That's not nothing.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: My name's on that forge whether or not the county wants to admit it.
